subject: M1 sign
what is implemented: Pr(delta_O > 0) >= 0.95, as Deliverable 3 and Appendix E have it: the contrast rises as the loss shrinks, so a mitigation raises it

subject: sum-to-zero
what the document says: Appendix E: each set of offsets is constrained to sum to zero
what is implemented: applied to the offset sets u_harm, u_bg, u_phase, u_stage and u_geometry, and not to beta_c, which is the configuration level itself and carries the M1 regression

subject: the denominator of R
what the document says: Deliverable 2 and Appendix E define R = A_pred / A_true, against the true continuation; the injected amplitude is the alternative
what is implemented: both are collected and 'true_continuation' is fitted; the control is RECOVERY_DENOMINATOR and it enters the run fingerprint

subject: D1 grid tolerance
what the document says: Appendix E: on a grid when the distance is within tolerance, with no number given
what is implemented: exact membership to 1e-06 Hz as primary, because the sweep grid contains the exact sites; 1 Hz fitted as a declared robustness reading

subject: D1 signal modes
what the document says: Appendix E: all three modes are fitted
what is implemented: all three are fitted and reported; the verdict is read from the two generator modes, because on a pure sinusoid the response depends on the floor and a stratum of identical values has no dispersion for a predictive check

subject: the sensitivity ladder
what the document says: Deliverable 3: every effect prior is varied over {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}
what is implemented: applied as a factor of 0.5, 1 and 2 on every prior scale, which reproduces those three for the priors tabulated at 0.5 and extends the rule to the families tabulated elsewhere

subject: D2 readings must agree
what the document says: tab:bayesDecisions gates D2 on ten unambiguous sites only
what is implemented: an operational gate is added: the preregistered fit and the fit restricted to geometries whose lowest detected site is the fundamental must reach the same decision

subject: background-only reading of Model A
what the document says: Appendix E states as a limitation that a line the model draws at a candidate site on its own is counted as recovery
what is implemented: every background is also forecast with no tone; Model A is refitted on the recovery net of that forecast, tone for tone, and must reach the same decision for H1 behavioural and M1, otherwise the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE

subject: refutation
what the document says: tab:bayesDecisions: refuted when the support probability falls to 0.05 or the equivalence rule reaches 0.95; equivalence rules are given for H1 only
what is implemented: the support-probability route is applied to every claim, H1 included, and equivalence rules in the form of H1's are added for M1 and H3 location; no support rule changes

subject: operational thresholds
what the document says: the report names the checks but not their thresholds
what is implemented: predictive coverage 90%, sensitivity band 0.1, recovery coverage and discrimination 80%, all declared here and recorded in the manifest
